stories.title: Blocage des lycées : plus de 800 interpellations en Ile-de-France depuis le début du mouvement, dont 85% de mineurs

en.title: High school blockades: over 800 arrests in Ile-de-France since start of movement, 85% minors
en.summary: More than 800 people have been arrested in the Ile-de-France region during high school blockades, with the majority being minors. Paris police report that 90% of those arrested were apprehended in their home departments.

stories.title: Qui est Hammam Al-Hammami, le pilote suspecté d’avoir planifié «un acte terroriste» sur le vol de Flydubai ?

en.title: Who is Hammam Al-Hammami, the pilot suspected of planning "a terrorist act" on the Flydubai flight?
en.summary: An Omani copilot attacked the aircraft commander with an axe during a Flydubai flight. He had concerning LinkedIn posts, spent time in Syria, and was previously banned from flying in Oman.

stories.title: Vol flydubai : l'enquête établit que le copilote planifiait un "acte terroriste"

en.title: Flydubai flight: investigation establishes that copilot was planning a "terrorist act"
en.summary: An investigation into an attack on a Flydubai flight determined the copilot used the cockpit emergency axe to attack the pilot in what authorities characterized as a terrorist act.

stories.title: Pilote poignardé, avion pour Tel-Aviv dérouté en Arabie Saoudite… Ce que l’on sait de l’attaque d’un copilote à bord d’un vol Flydubai

en.title: Pilot stabbed, plane to Tel-Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia… What we know about the attack by a copilot aboard a Flydubai flight
en.summary: A Flydubai aircraft traveling from Dubai to Israel experienced a sudden altitude loss and landed in Tabuk on September 30. The UAE's prosecutor general announced that one pilot carried out a terrorist act.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : la Russie a attaqué un deuxième pont majeur à Kiev

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Russia attacked a second major bridge in Kyiv
en.summary: Russia targeted a second major bridge in Kyiv on Saturday morning, after previously attacking the Pivdenny Bridge. The Pivnitchny Bridge, located further north on the Dnieper River, was struck during the assault.

stories.title: Le copilote du vol Flydubai volant vers Tel-Aviv planifiait un « acte terroriste » en le déroutant, selon l’enquête des Emirats arabes unis

en.title: Flydubai copilot flying to Tel-Aviv planned a "terrorist act" by diverting the plane, according to UAE investigation
en.summary: A UAE investigation determined that a Flydubai copilot intended to carry out a terrorist act by diverting the aircraft. It is unclear whether the copilot's background was verified when he was hired by the airline.

stories.title: Vol Flydubai : l’enquête établit que le copilote planifiait un «acte terroriste», il a attaqué le pilote avec la hache de secours du cockpit

en.title: Flydubai flight: investigation establishes that copilot planned a "terrorist act", he attacked the pilot with the cockpit emergency axe
en.summary: An investigation found that the copilot planned a terrorist act and attacked the pilot using an emergency axe from the cockpit. The aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after nosediving and transmitting two emergency codes.

stories.title: 🔴 Vol Flydubai : l'enquête émiratie établit que le copilote omanais planifiait un "acte terroriste"

en.title: Flydubai flight: UAE investigation establishes that Omani copilot planned a "terrorist act"
en.summary: A UAE investigation concluded that the Omani copilot of a Flydubai flight planned a terrorist act.

stories.title: Le copilote du vol FlyDubai qui a agressé son commandant de bord planifiait un "acte terroriste", affirme le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis

en.title: FlyDubai copilot who assaulted captain was planning a "terrorist act", says UAE prosecutor general
en.summary: The prosecutor general of the United Arab Emirates has stated that the copilot involved in an assault on a FlyDubai flight was planning a terrorist act.

stories.title: «Je suis content du contenu, pas du résultat» : pour leur premier match en France, les Bleus de Zidane tenus en échec par l’Italie

en.title: "I am happy with the content, not the result": for their first match in France, Zidane's Blues held to a draw by Italy
en.summary: France's football team drew 1-1 with Italy in their first match under Zidane at the Stade de France on Friday evening.

stories.title: Vol Flydubai : le copilote à l’origine de l’attaque planifiait un «acte terroriste» et était interdit de vol par les autorités d’Oman

en.title: FlyDubai flight: copilot behind attack was planning a "terrorist act" and was banned from flying by Omani authorities
en.summary: The UAE prosecutor general announced that the copilot was preparing a terrorist act. Omani authorities had previously banned him from flying after he reportedly became radicalized during time in Syria.

stories.title: En Ukraine, un autre pont important de Kiev touché par une frappe russe

en.title: In Ukraine, another important Kyiv bridge hit by Russian strike
en.summary: Kyiv's North Bridge was struck by Russian forces on Saturday, damaging the road surface and trolleybus cables, following an earlier attack on the South Bridge.

stories.title: « Mon père est inégalable » : Le Petit Nicolas fait sa rentrée sous la plume de la fille Goscinny

en.title: "My father is unmatched": Little Nicholas returns to school under the pen of Goscinny's daughter
en.summary: The popular French schoolboy character and his friends return to school, with Anne Goscinny, daughter of the character's creator, sharing an exclusive drawing for the publication.

stories.title: Automobile : les constructeurs américains talonnés par les marques asiatiques et leurs véhicules hybrides

en.title: Automobiles: Asian brands closing gap with American manufacturers through hybrid vehicles
en.summary: Asian automakers are gaining market share in the United States against established domestic manufacturers, with hybrid powertrains attracting consumers amid rising oil prices.

stories.title: OPINION. « L’attractivité de la destination France se gagne aussi dans les airs »

en.title: OPINION. "France's attractiveness as a destination is also won in the air"
en.summary: France must prioritize air connectivity as a cornerstone of its national and regional tourism strategy to maintain its position as a leading tourism destination.

stories.title: En Lozère, l'usine d'ArcelorMittal surfe sur la vague des voitures électriques

en.title: In Lozère, ArcelorMittal's plant rides the electric vehicle wave
en.summary: ArcelorMittal's facility in Saint-Chély-d'Apcher has become a key supplier of steel for electric vehicle motors in Europe within a decade, with plans to expand support for European automakers.

stories.title: OPINION. « Sacrifier les CEE, c’est sacrifier notre avenir »

en.title: OPINION. "Sacrificing CEE is sacrificing our future"
en.summary: French consumers face rising energy prices that reduce purchasing power. Some public figures propose eliminating CEE mechanisms as a quick solution to lower fuel prices, though critics question this approach.
